svg.title: Ammar Munir
svg.desc: Lead engineer at Arq Tech. An animated agent trace answers the question what does ammar build: it routes the question, expands it into sub-queries, runs dense and sparse retrieval fused with reciprocal rank fusion, reranks with a cross-encoder, and answers with citations to Arq Tech, Turing and INOVAQO.
svg.text: I build agentic RAG and LLM systems that answer with their sources.

g.text: dense + sparse search, scoped to one organization

text.tspan: Agentic RAG and LLM systems, from prototype to production:
hybrid retrieval, reranking, memory and cited answers

g.text: Arq Tech, lead engineer on an AI compliance platform, 2025–now
Turing, LLM post-training data and RLHF evaluation, 2023
INOVAQO, generative AI projects end to end, 2024–25
